answer: A newcomer stakes a refundable 420 POA bond for 120 days to cross the bridge into paid work, locked to one device key so a farm cannot split one stake across a thousand fake agents. A comet check arrives with no warning, one live task due in 15 minutes, and a missed check freezes the bond. Each month three auditors picked at random reopen one finished job from the basalt ledger and check it line by line, and a forged entry burns the whole bond and bars the key for a year.
